The first stable release of **Bolum**: push-to-talk dictation for macOS, Windows and Linux. Press a shortcut, speak, and the transcript is typed into whatever app has focus. Speech recognition runs entirely on your computer.

## Highlights

- **Local transcription.** Whisper runs through whisper.cpp, with Metal acceleration on Apple Silicon. NVIDIA Parakeet and Canary run through ONNX Runtime.
- **Nine models, from 44 MB to 670 MB.** They range from Whisper Tiny (near-instant) to Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2/v3 (best accuracy). Recommended picks are marked. Every download is verified against a pinned SHA-256.
- **macOS-native design.** A translucent sidebar, System Settings-style controls, and a purple theme in light and dark. The menu-bar icon adapts to your menu bar.
- **Recording overlay.** A small pill with a live waveform, and a cancel button while listening.
- **Shortcut recorder.** Push-to-talk or toggle mode. On Wayland and Hyprland, `bolum toggle` works from a compositor keybinding.
- **Text delivery.** Typed, pasted from the clipboard, or only kept in History.
- **Optional LLM cleanup.** Send the transcript through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as Ollama or LM Studio, before it is inserted.
- **History.** Every dictation is kept on your computer, with copy and delete.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 13.4+ on Apple Silicon | `Bolum_1.0.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `Bolum_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.39+ | `Bolum_1.0.0_amd64.AppImage` |
| Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04+ | `Bolum_1.0.0_amd64.deb` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for each file.

## First launch

**macOS.** Drag Bolum to Applications. This build isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Bolum.app`. Then allow **Microphone** and **Accessibility** access when asked. Bolum lives in the menu bar and has no Dock icon.

**Windows.** Run the setup `.exe`. It isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info → Run anyway**. The installer fetches the WebView2 runtime if it is missing. Bolum lives in the notification area.

**Linux.** Run `chmod +x Bolum_1.0.0_amd64.AppImage` and start the file, or install with `sudo apt install ./Bolum_1.0.0_amd64.deb`. Text insertion needs a typing tool (`wtype`, `xdotool`, `ydotool`, `dotool` or `kwtype`) and a clipboard tool (`wl-copy`, `xclip` or `xsel`).

Then open **Models**, download one, and press the shortcut (⌃⌥Space by default).

## Known limitations

- There is no macOS build for Intel Macs in this release. To use Bolum on one, build it from source.
- The macOS app is not notarized, and the Windows installer is not code-signed, so you need the first-launch steps above.
